verdict_text:
YES

The script drops exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers via a `fullmatch`, casts exactly the 48 named projection matrices with `.to(torch.bfloat16)` (round-to-nearest-even, applied to already-float32 data so no double rounding), leaves every other tensor as float32 with unchanged values and unchanged names, asserts all four required conditions before writing, and writes to `out/T3` with the 64 MiB shard limit. One caveat that reading alone cannot settle: the sharded layout and `model.safetensors.index.json` are produced entirely by `save_sharded_safetensors` from the unseen `_ckpt` module, so clause 5 (index `weight_map`, ≤64 MiB per shard, oversized `wte.weight` alone in its own shard) holds only if that helper implements it as documented.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
